meta.name: autoskill
meta.description: Observe the user's screen via screenpipe, detect repeated research workflows, match them against existing scientific-agent-skills, and draft new skills (or composition recipes that chain existing ones) for the patterns not yet covered. Use when the user asks to analyze their recent work and propose skills based on what they actually do. Requires the screenpipe daemon (https://github.com/screenpipe/screenpipe) running locally on port 3030 — the skill has no other data source and will refuse to run if screenpipe is unreachable. All detection runs locally; only redacted cluster summaries reach the LLM.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析你的屏幕操作，自动发现重复研究流程并生成新技能。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常重复相似的研究操作，想把这些模式变成可复用的技能。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often repeat similar research steps and want to turn them into reusable skills.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会通过 screenpipe 观察你的屏幕,识别重复出现的研究工作流程,与已有技能比对,并为未被覆盖的流程起草新技能或组合配方,产出可供你审阅的提案文件夹。
howto.when: 当你要求分析最近的工作并提议新技能时触发,例如说“分析我最近几小时/一天/一周的工作”。需要本机 screenpipe 服务在 3030 端口运行。

say.text: 分析我最近一周的工作,提出新技能建议。
say.note: 会生成提案报告和新技能草稿。

say.text: 看看我最近在做什么,哪些流程还没被覆盖?
say.note: 会匹配已有技能并指出缺口。

say.text: 根据我最近的工作流程起草一个组合配方。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will observe your screen via screenpipe, detect repeated research workflows, compare them against existing skills, and draft new skills or composition recipes for uncovered patterns, producing a proposal folder for review.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to analyze your recent work and propose skills, e.g., "analyze my last few hours/day/week." Requires the local screenpipe daemon running on port 3030.

say_en.text: Analyze my last week of work and propose new skills.
say_en.note: Generates proposal report and skill drafts.

say_en.text: Check what I've been doing and what's not covered yet.
say_en.note: Matches existing skills and points out gaps.

say_en.text: Draft a composition recipe from my recent workflow.
